description: Source code for the devtools application in Playwright, managing HTTP server, WebSocket connections, browser automation, and devtools UI.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: HTTP server handling API routes, static file serving, and WebSocket connections for devtools.

classes.name: CDPConnection
classes.description: Represents a Chrome DevTools Protocol connection to a page.

classes.name: DevToolsConnection
classes.description: Manages connection to DevTools sessions and pages.

methods.name: readBody
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON body from an HTTP request.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses incoming request to extract GUID.

methods.name: sendJSON
methods.description: Sends JSON response with optional status code.

methods.name: loadBrowserDescriptorSessions
methods.description: Loads active browser sessions from server registry.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Handles API requests for session listing, closing, and data deletion.

methods.name: openDevToolsApp
methods.description: Starts the devtools HTTP server, WebSocket, and launches the devtools page.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Launches Chromium with devtools UI and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: syncLocalStorageWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes localStorage settings between the page and a JSON file.

methods.name: devtoolsSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs socket path based on user hash.

methods.name: acquireSingleton
methods.description: Creates or connects to singleton server socket for devtools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to start devtools server and application.
